question: F26 implementation: dawn bloom has no approved 64x80 planter growth sheet. Would an expedition-only dawn bloom (no planter) keep the planned economy?
method: probe_f26_economy.gd --mode=complete --hours=6 --no-garden, seeds 73129/19337/9973 (same start as summary.json complete). Sanity: without --no-garden seed 73129 reproduces summary.json (744,693/h).
conclusion: Expedition-only dawn bloom cuts new-potion sales by about 82% and the gain from +14.1% to about +2.4% (payback ~24 h -> ~140 h). It breaks the approved economy, so the planter (26 s, clear x1.5) is kept and simply shown without a growth sheet (the code already treats growth art as optional).
